The reference is now the REAL @astryxdesign/core@0.1.6 render — extract/computed/out/astryx/<comp>/orig-shots/<combo>__default.png, committed for the first time by `extract/computed/run.ts --keep-originals`. defects: FC-TEXT-WRAP: shot content box 115x80 vs library 119x48. The canvas cell is narrow enough that "Card content" wraps to two lines and the cell grows to 80px tall; the library renders one line at 48px. A width/wrap defect in the emitted set, not a reference-framing artifact — the reference is the library’s own render.

FC-THEME-BASE: the capture mount renders under `<Theme theme={neutralTheme}>` (@astryxdesign/theme-neutral — the library’s documented Quick Start and the only mount where the base font resolves), while examples/astryx/tokens/astryx.dtcg.json is wrapped from @astryxdesign/core/src/theme/tokens.stylex.ts, the CORE DEFAULT palette. Measured: core --color-accent #0064E0 vs theme-neutral #262626; core --color-text-primary #0A1317 vs #171717; core --color-background-blue #0171E333 vs #c4ddfb. The canvas paints the core plane, the library renders the neutral plane, and no re-promote closes it: promoting from the neutral captures strands 30 of the 36 acked re-anchoring rows (65 leaves) with no alias target, dropping the astryx bundle from 54 Figma-native aliases to 13 and failing the plugin-engine-check pin. A HUMAN decision on which plane is astryx’s canonical repo-side theme is required; nothing was force-fitted. Card Variant=Default: the library paints a WHITE surface with a 1px border; the canvas paints a blue fill.
